# laravelforge_site_octane (Resource)

Manages the Laravel Octane integration for a Laravel Forge site (singleton per site). The presence of the resource means Octane is enabled; destroying it disables Octane. The Forge API exposes no update endpoint, so changing any input forces a destroy and recreate.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `port` (String) Port Octane listens on.
- `server` (String) Octane application server. One of `swoole`, `roadrunner`, `frankenphp`.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server the site belongs to.
- `site_id` (Number) ID of the site to enable the Octane integration on.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (String) Whether the Octane integration is enabled, as reported by Forge.
- `installed_port` (Number) Port Octane is configured to listen on, as reported by Forge.
- `octane_installed` (Boolean) Whether the Octane package is installed on the site.
